asm_ida_com:
push    rbp
mov     rbp, rsp
mov     [rbp+A], rdi
mov     [rbp+k], esi
mov     eax, [rbp+k]
mov     ecx, 20h ; ' '
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     [rbp+i], eax
mov     eax, [rbp+k]
mov     ecx, 20h ; ' '
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     [rbp+pos], edx
mov     [rbp+flag], 1
mov     eax, [rbp+flag]
mov     ecx, [rbp+pos]
shl     eax, cl
mov     [rbp+flag], eax
mov     rax, [rbp+A]
movsxd  rcx, [rbp+i]
mov     edx, [rax+rcx*4]
or      edx, [rbp+flag]
mov     rax, [rbp+A]
movsxd  rcx, [rbp+i]
mov     [rax+rcx*4], edx
pop     rbp
retn
